title: Panegyric and Thanksgiving to Origen (opening tip)
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
edition: Vossius 1684 Opera omnia Latin column Oratio panegyrica et charisteria; tip densify opening; Greek column OCR damaged
blurb: Gregory Thaumaturgus, Panegyric Oration and Thanksgiving to Origen — tip densify of the opening from the 1684 Latin column. New English for private study; ANF 6 Salmond exists. Tip covers silence, eight years without oratory, and hesitation before the subject.
era_note: Delivered at Caesarea in Palestine as Gregory prepared to return home after study under Origen. Jerome De viris illustribus under Theodore attests the oration; Vossius Argumentum is editorial and not part of the tipped text.
first_english_note: Prior English exists ANF 6 Salmond PD; this is a new rendering from locked Latin for the tipped opening.

text_history.method: English densified from locked Vossius 1684 Latin column for tip opening; Greek column OCR too damaged to lock; Vossius Argumentum/scholia stripped; ANF 6 consulted only as sense check; earlier scaffold summary discarded.

joins.note: Long-s and column joins expanded from the Latin face ductu; nec aut scripsi; historiamve; arte nostra; Greek face left aside as damaged OCR; Argumentum G. Vossii stripped.
